name: Dubhan
role: maker of the first working dubhan; wins the charter of export (DE 27)
notes: Owner's character. Master facts only (V-0115, VI-0001, VI-0154b): no invented words, thoughts, kin or deeds; seen from outside.

name: Seachran
role: of Splatter and Dodge's generation; one of Dubhan's closest allies
notes: Owner's character (V-0100). May be named as Dubhan's ally; does nothing.

name: Brean
role: of Splatter and Dodge's generation; one of Dubhan's closest allies

name: Mairead
role: ruler of Rìoghachd Dia-thìr until DE 3
notes: Owner's character. Her reign 'ended'; give no cause.

name: Cathal
role: ruler of Rìoghachd Dia-thìr, crowned 1 an Lùnastal DE 3 by Macha's rite; reigning DE 27
notes: Owner's character (VI-0006). Is crowned and reigns; the council acts, never he.

name: Beathag nic Fhionnlaigh
role: royal chronicler SE 65 – DE 20; principal
notes: Master (V-0220, VI-0002, VI-0049a, VI-0069, VI-0074). Retires to her sister's house at Àth dhìreach; her death DE 26 is a new era event.

name: Sìleas nic Rath
role: Beathag's clerk from DE 11; royal chronicler from DE 20; principal
notes: Master (VI-0074, VI-0129, VI-0156). Her full war record is sealed.

name: Raghnall mac Mhuirich
role: keeper of Leabharlann Muileann chaol

name: Peigi nic Ascaill
role: engineer to the Lighthouse Board; master-fitter at the southern Seann Skell works; a first master of the Fuel-Fitters; principal
notes: Master (VI-0011). Lets her Tuathaich fitters go under the charter rule (DE 14); signs the regiments' contract (DE 24).

name: Joe Ashby
role: Tuathach fitter of Caol mhòr; turns the Baile chrom light; let go under the charter rule; fits boats outside any guild; principal
notes: New. Human name. Never learns or reveals how the shipmasters came by the making; no link to Dubhan.

name: Martha Greaves
role: mill manager of Doire ghlas; speaker of the Moot DE 8–25; principal

name: Ruth Calder
role: pit captain's daughter of Àth leathan; spokeswoman of the five holdout towns; principal
notes: Master (VI-0055, VI-0071, VI-0079, VI-0082). Fate after 11 an Giblean DE 21 unknown: no POV past the dawn of the battle.

name: Ellen Marsh
role: schoolteacher of Doire ghlas; gatherer of the eleven books of Tuathaich accounts; principal
notes: Master (VI-0058, VI-0061, VI-0097, VI-0152). Her twelfth book (the war) is a new era detail, kept in the north.

name: Somhairle mac Lachlainn
role: captain of the Board's enforcers; commander of the regiments; seated on the council DE 23; principal
notes: Master (VI-0076, VI-0124). Told close only where the record is open (not during DE 21–22).

name: Daniel Frayne
role: speaker of the Moot SE 55 – DE 8

name: Peter Hale
role: Moot delegate; carries the rebound minute-books; speaker from DE 25
notes: Master (VI-0139, VI-0153). Great-grandson of Walter Hale.

name: Tom Varley
role: pit captain of Cnoc thais; reopens two shafts; holdout leader in the hills
notes: Master (VI-0056, VI-0079). Goes out onto the windy coast DE 21 (new); last seen there; death unknown.

name: Owen Barrow
role: leader of the column, named only in the Tuathaich tellings
notes: Master (VI-0111). No POV; his reason is sealed; the open record names him not at all.

name: Anna nic Phàil
role: councillor for Cathair dhomhain; brings the motion for amends
